capabilities: Save a layout (splits, ratios, editor modes, non-file views) for a file via a command
Apply saved layouts automatically when opening files matched by glob patterns
Restrict layouts to specific platforms such as mobile or desktop
Load any saved layout on demand with an adhoc command
Show tab icons indicating whether a layout's integrity is intact
disambiguation: Not a theming or CSS layout tool; it manages the arrangement of tabs, splits and view modes in the main workspace per file.
extras: README warns a layout can only contain one markdown file, and that mobile re-organizes splits into tabs, which the plugin cannot control.
intentEvidence: Workspaces don't offer a contextual layout feature
problem: Obsidian Workspaces are static snapshots of open files, so layouts cannot be tied to which file you open.

relations.evidence: Workspaces don't offer a contextual layout feature, but rather a static

summary: Layout manager that saves tab and split arrangements and automatically applies them when opening a file matching a glob pattern.
